title: Teacher-written information text 'Elizabeth I: The Last Tudor'
subject: English
unit: Summer 2: Time Traveller and Off with Her Head!
source: Written for english/y5 lesson 85 (Teacher-written information text 'Elizabeth I: The Last Tudor' (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 85: Tudor research skills: skim, scan and note-take. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

passage.title: Teacher-written information text for TGA
paras: Elizabeth was born at Greenwich Palace in 1533. Her father was King Henry VIII. She became queen in 1558, when she was 25, and ruled for 44 years.
In 1588, the Spanish Armada, a great fleet of warships, sailed to invade England. It was defeated, and storms scattered many of its ships.
Elizabeth never married. When she died in 1603, the Tudor line ended.

head: Job
Skill
rows: What is the whole text about?

model.title: Note: She became queen in 1558, when she was 25, and ruled for 44 years.

parts.text: Find the key facts: 1558, aged 25, 44 years

keywords.def: read quickly to get the main idea
look quickly for a particular word, number or name
write key facts briefly in your own words
the royal family that ruled England from 1485 to 1603

questions.a: the defeat of the Spanish Armada

questions.q: Make a note: She was born at Greenwich Palace in 1533.
Core: complete the note-taking grid: birth, family, reign, events, death
questions.a: Five rows of notes in own words

questions.q: Extend: work out how old Elizabeth was when she died
questions.a: About 70, because 1603 - 1533 = 70 (she was in fact 69: she died in March, before her September birthday)

questions.q: Stretch: write two research questions you would like to answer next
questions.a: For example: Why did she never marry? Who ruled after her?

questions.q: To find the year of the Armada, you should...
questions.a: A) scan for a date. Scanning for a number finds a date quickly.
